column1: # Source tags: where an algorithm's code comes from. Read by `cargo xtask gen` (docs/algo.generated.json,
# field `source`) and tools/catalog/gen_catalog.py. Every algorithm must match exactly one rule, or gen stops.
#   match  crate            a Rust crate from crates.io (upstream.crate)
#          url:<host>       a download from <host> (upstream.url); an https://web.archive.org/web/<time>/<orig>
#                           copy is matched by the host of <orig> and also gets the flag `web-archive`
# Flags added to any tag: `web-archive` (archived copy of the original URL), `port` (upstream/port/: a
# line-by-line port from another language, CLAUDE.md rule 1).
#   nist         NIST competition or standardisation submission package, as published by NIST
#   supercop     SUPERCOP (eBACS) benchmark package: implementations submitted by the designers
#   phc          Password Hashing Competition submission package
#   pqclean      PQClean (clean, reviewed PQC reference code)
#   designer     the designers' own reference code
#   crates-io    a Rust crate (RustCrypto and others), exact version pinned
#   mirror       an old crypto archive mirror
#   third-party  an individual's implementation, not the designers' and not a library
